name: Real-World Project Setup
description: Set up real project structures from scratch: a Python script, a Markdown documentation site, and a data processing pipeline.

tasks.description: Create a small Python project with the following structure: project_root/main.py, project_root/README.md, project_root/requirements.txt. main.py should contain a Python script that prints 'Project setup complete!'. README.md should describe the project. requirements.txt should list 'requests' and 'pytest'.
tasks.expected_outcome: A complete Python project structure exists with all required files

tasks.description: Create a mini documentation site structure: docs/index.md, docs/guide/getting-started.md, docs/api/reference.md. Each file should have a proper Markdown heading and at least 2 lines of content. index.md should link to the other pages.
tasks.expected_outcome: A nested documentation directory structure with linked Markdown files

tasks.description: Create a data processing pipeline: 1) Create raw_data.csv with 5 rows of sample data (name,value). 2) Create a script process.py that reads raw_data.csv, filters rows where value > 50, sorts them descending by value, and writes the result to filtered_data.csv. 3) Run the script to verify it works.
tasks.expected_outcome: filtered_data.csv exists with correctly filtered and sorted data
